messages.subject: STOP ERROR in calc_uppass_scenario_probs_new2(): NAs found in sum_relprob_each_split_scenario
parts:
Hi all,

I keep running into this error: STOP ERROR in calc_uppass_scenario_probs_new2(): NAs found in sum_relprob_each_split_scenario.
All the calculations before seem to work fine and I get the usual output with all optimal parameter values, but right at the end, when the results should be written to an .Rdata object, I get this error. This is very unfortunate since the optimization process, which takes ca. 8h in my case on a cluster, needs to have finished for me to realize that there's a problem somewhere.

I'm also not sure what causes the error. It only appears when I try the trait-dependent extension (+m2). All base models (DEC, DIVA, BAYAREA) and +x models work fine. In another case, increasing the state space helped, but with this one I'm at a loss.
Have I made the estimation impossible because of constraints? but why would it work with the base and +x models then? Can the estimations be so different? Is there a way to know this before running the whole optimization process?

Has anyone else run into this error? Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Sarah
